dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『あぁ、もう、恥ずかしい恥ずかしい恥ずかし
　い恥ずかしい恥ずかしいったら、恥ずかしかっ
　たよ〜！！』
dialogues.en: "Oh my god. I can't believe it. I'm so embarrassed."
dialogues.text: "Oh my god. I can't believe it. I'm so embarrassed."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁな」
dialogues.en: "I guess......"
dialogues.text: "I guess......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『あぁ、もう、どうやって明日から美春とか白
　河さんに会えばいいの？』
dialogues.en: "How can I face Miharu and Shirakawa-san from now on?"
dialogues.text: "How can I face Miharu and Shirakawa-san from now on?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……普通に会えば良いんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "Same as usual, I suppose."
dialogues.text: "Same as usual, I suppose."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『しかも、なんで困ってるのに顔がにやつくの
　よ、も〜！』
dialogues.en: "Why's my face smiling when I'm really in trouble?"
dialogues.text: "Why's my face smiling when I'm really in trouble?"

dialogues.jp: どたばた、と音夢が隣の部屋で暴れている。
dialogues.en: Nemu's making all kinds of noise in her room.
dialogues.text: Nemu's making all kinds of noise in her room.

dialogues.jp:
夕方からまた調子を崩してベッドで寝ているは
ずなのだが、一体なにをしているのやら……。
dialogues.en:
She didn't feel well after that, so she should be sleeping
in bed. I wonder what she's up to.
dialogues.text:
She didn't feel well after that, so she should be sleeping
in bed. I wonder what she's up to.

dialogues.jp: 部屋の天井から埃が降ってきそうな勢いだ。
dialogues.en: She's shaking the whole house.
dialogues.text: She's shaking the whole house.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、その独り言に｛あいづち／相槌｝を打っている俺も俺
　だがな」
dialogues.en:
"I feel like a dork answering to her when she's talking to
herself."
dialogues.text:
"I feel like a dork answering to her when she's talking to
herself."

dialogues.jp:
机の椅子に座ってマンガを読みながら、同じく
にやけてしまう頬を整える。
dialogues.en:
I'm sitting on the chair reading a manga while trying to
keep straight face.
dialogues.text:
I'm sitting on the chair reading a manga while trying to
keep straight face.

dialogues.jp:
「世間では、壁越しにノックしてくるような可
　愛い妹もいるというのに……うちのときたら」
dialogues.en:
"There are shy younger sisters who knock on the wall to get
attention out there. But Nemu's not one, that's for
sure......"
dialogues.text:
"There are shy younger sisters who knock on the wall to get
attention out there. But Nemu's not one, that's for
sure......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『うわぁ！　日記に書いちゃって、お父さんや
　お母さんに読まれたらどうするのよ！』
dialogues.en:
"Oh no! What if Mom and Dad read my diary? I shouldn't write
that!!"
dialogues.text:
"Oh no! What if Mom and Dad read my diary? I shouldn't write
that!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「読ませるなよ……それは絶対に」
dialogues.en: "Don't write it......"
dialogues.text: "Don't write it......"

dialogues.jp:
と言うか、そろそろ止めないと近所迷惑で怒ら
れそうだ。
dialogues.en:
Maybe I should stop her now since the neighbors might be
upset from all the noise she's making.
dialogues.text:
Maybe I should stop her now since the neighbors might be
upset from all the noise she's making.

dialogues.jp:
いや、むしろ、近所の人間に聞かれること自体
まずいだろうが……。
dialogues.en:
But, it would be bad if the neighbors are able to hear what
she's talking about......
dialogues.text:
But, it would be bad if the neighbors are able to hear what
she's talking about......

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おばんです〜、は北海道の方言だよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Good evening!"
dialogues.text: "Good evening!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……しかも、うるさい奴が増えたし」
dialogues.en: "And here comes the troublemaker."
dialogues.text: "And here comes the troublemaker."

dialogues.jp: マンガから顔を上げる。
dialogues.en: I lift my eyes from the manga.
dialogues.text: I lift my eyes from the manga.

dialogues.jp:
ポン、とベッドの上に座り込んでいるピンク色
の物体がにっこりと笑う。
dialogues.en: The pink thing sitting on my bed smiles at me.
dialogues.text: The pink thing sitting on my bed smiles at me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、音夢ちゃんなに壊れて――」
dialogues.en: "Hey, what happened to Nemu-chan?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what happened to Nemu-chan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『あぁ、もう違う意味でお嫁に行けないよ〜』
dialogues.en: "I can't get married now."
dialogues.text: "I can't get married now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと待ってろ」
dialogues.en: "Wait right here......"
dialogues.text: "Wait right here......"

dialogues.jp: 頭を抱えながら壁を足でノックする。
dialogues.en: I kicked the wall with my foot as I shook my head.
dialogues.text: I kicked the wall with my foot as I shook my head.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢っ！　近所迷惑だから静かにしろ！」
dialogues.en: "Nemu! Shut up! Everyone can hear you!!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu! Shut up! Everyone can hear you!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『うわっ！　兄さん聞こえてたの！？』
dialogues.en: "Oh my god! You heard me?"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god! You heard me?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「家の外まで響いてるわ！　調子が良くないな
　らとっとと寝ろ！」
dialogues.en:
"Everyone in the neighborhood can hear you! Go to sleep if
you aren't feeling well!"
dialogues.text:
"Everyone in the neighborhood can hear you! Go to sleep if
you aren't feeling well!"

dialogues.jp:
ごそごそ、と音がした後、ようやく隣室が静ま
り返った。
dialogues.en: She made some noise and then her room became quiet.
dialogues.text: She made some noise and then her room became quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お嫁にいけないの音夢ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu-chan can't get married?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu-chan can't get married?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いけると思うぞ俺は」
dialogues.en: "I'm sure she can."
dialogues.text: "I'm sure she can."

dialogues.jp: さくらのすぐ近くの階段に腰掛けてうなだれる。
dialogues.en: I looked down as I sat down close to Sakura.
dialogues.text: I looked down as I sat down close to Sakura.

dialogues.jp: まぁ、いかせるかどうかは別だが。
dialogues.en: Whether I'd let her or not is a different matter.
dialogues.text: Whether I'd let her or not is a different matter.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ。その後、調子はどうかなお兄ちゃん？
　音夢ちゃんは元気そうだけど」
dialogues.en: "Hmm. How do you feel now? Nemu-chan seems to be all right."
dialogues.text: "Hmm. How do you feel now? Nemu-chan seems to be all right."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、それを確認に来たのか？」
dialogues.en: "You came to check on us?"
dialogues.text: "You came to check on us?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 恥ずかしさなど｛みじん／微塵｝もなくさくらが頷く。
dialogues.en: Sakura nodded.
dialogues.text: Sakura nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「俺か？　まぁまぁだな」
dialogues.en: "Me? I guess I'm all right."
dialogues.text: "Me? I guess I'm all right."

dialogues.jp: ｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺しながら｛つぶや／呟｝く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled trying to stifle a yawn.
dialogues.text: I mumbled trying to stifle a yawn.

dialogues.jp:
「んん……陽気がいいからかなんか眠いけど、
　今何時だ？」
dialogues.en:
"Phew. It's so nice outside that it's making me sleepy. What
time is it?"
dialogues.text:
"Phew. It's so nice outside that it's making me sleepy. What
time is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まだ９時だよ」
dialogues.en: "It's nine o'clock."
dialogues.text: "It's nine o'clock."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp: 時計を見るが、確かに９時だ。
dialogues.en: I looked at the clock. It's nine o'clock.
dialogues.text: I looked at the clock. It's nine o'clock.

dialogues.jp:
「おかしいな、もう日付が変わるころかと思っ
　たのに」
dialogues.en: "That's weird. I thought it was about midnight."
dialogues.text: "That's weird. I thought it was about midnight."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに眠いの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you that sleepy?"
dialogues.text: "Are you that sleepy?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん……あぁ」
ちょっと反応が遅れる。
dialogues.en: I responded slowly.
dialogues.text: I responded slowly.

dialogues.jp: 「急に眠くなったな……」
dialogues.en: "I feel sleepy all of a sudden......"
dialogues.text: "I feel sleepy all of a sudden......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ。お兄ちゃん膝枕してあげようか♪」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you want to sleep on my lap?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you want to sleep on my lap?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いいって」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "No, I'm fine."

dialogues.jp: 頭を振って大きく息を吸う。
dialogues.en: I shook my head and took a deep breath.
dialogues.text: I shook my head and took a deep breath.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ねぇねぇ、明日ボクと遊びに行かない？　買
　い物につきあって欲しいんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, do you want to go out with me tomorrow? I want you to
go shopping with me."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, do you want to go out with me tomorrow? I want you to
go shopping with me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「明日？　明日かぁ」
dialogues.en: "Tomorrow? Let's see......"
dialogues.text: "Tomorrow? Let's see......"

dialogues.jp:
確か音夢は、委員会の会議で出かけるって言っ
てたよな。
dialogues.en:
Nemu said that she has a school committee meeting she has to
attend.
dialogues.text:
Nemu said that she has a school committee meeting she has to
attend.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、夕方までならいいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Maybe until dinner time."
dialogues.text: "Maybe until dinner time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ、ほんとに？　嘘ついたら切腹だよ？」
dialogues.en: "Really? You better not be lying or I'll kill you."
dialogues.text: "Really? You better not be lying or I'll kill you."

dialogues.jp:
さくらが隣にちょこんと座りながら俺を見上げ
る。
dialogues.en: Sakura sat next to me and looked up to me.
dialogues.text: Sakura sat next to me and looked up to me.

dialogues.jp: 「切腹はしないけど、嘘はつかないって」
dialogues.en: "I don't want to die, but I'm not lying."
dialogues.text: "I don't want to die, but I'm not lying."

dialogues.jp:
思わず苦笑いを浮かべて、さくらの頭に手をお
く。
dialogues.en: I smiled and put my hand on top of her head.
dialogues.text: I smiled and put my hand on top of her head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ〜い♪　デート、デート！」
dialogues.en: "Okay, it's a date, then."
dialogues.text: "Okay, it's a date, then."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おい、買い物だろうが」
dialogues.en: "Wow, I thought it was just a shopping trip."
dialogues.text: "Wow, I thought it was just a shopping trip."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お花見しようよ〜、日本人の心には桜がなく
　ちゃダメだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Let's go see the cherry blossoms. They should be beautiful
by now."
dialogues.text:
"Let's go see the cherry blossoms. They should be beautiful
by now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「聞いてるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you listening?"
dialogues.text: "Are you listening?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ノープロブレム！　買い物で遊んでデートだ
　よ♪　お花見、芸者、忍者でござるよ」
dialogues.en: "No problem. It's a shopping date."
dialogues.text: "No problem. It's a shopping date."

dialogues.jp:
チチチ、とわけの分からなさ過ぎることを言っ
てさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiled.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiled.

dialogues.jp: 「……ったく」
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.jp:
ため息だか欠伸だか分からない空気を漏らして、
明日の予定を思い出す。
dialogues.en: I sighed and tried to remember the schedule for tomorrow.
dialogues.text: I sighed and tried to remember the schedule for tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、音夢が帰ってくるまでなら問題な
いだろう。
dialogues.en: I'm sure it won't be a problem until Nemu comes home.
dialogues.text: I'm sure it won't be a problem until Nemu comes home.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　どうしたのお兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "What? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Nothing."
dialogues.text: "Nothing."

dialogues.jp: 思わず吹き出してしまった。
dialogues.en: It made me laugh.
dialogues.text: It made me laugh.

dialogues.jp:
音夢と一緒にいられる時間を数えているなんて、
俺も焼きが回ったもんだ。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't believe I was thinking about how I can make a
plan around Nemu's schedule.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't believe I was thinking about how I can make a
plan around Nemu's schedule.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、明日の朝起こしに……どうせだから
　一緒に寝ててもいい？」
dialogues.en:
"Then I'll come over to wake you up...... or can I just stay
here tonight?"
dialogues.text:
"Then I'll come over to wake you up...... or can I just stay
here tonight?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「帰れ」
dialogues.en: "Go home."
dialogues.text: "Go home."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「残念無念……それじゃ、今日は夜更かししちゃ
　ダメだよお兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "That's too bad. Don't stay up too late, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "That's too bad. Don't stay up too late, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Fine."
dialogues.text: "Fine."

dialogues.jp: 分かったよ、と手を振って目をこする。
dialogues.en: I waved at her and rubbed my eyes.
dialogues.text: I waved at her and rubbed my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Are you sleepy?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sleepy?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん……ああ。ちょっと横になってもいいか？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... Can I lie down now?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... Can I lie down now?"

dialogues.jp: なんだか頭の中がぼう、としてきていた。
dialogues.en: I felt really sleepy I couldn't think.
dialogues.text: I felt really sleepy I couldn't think.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「夢、見るかな？」
dialogues.en: "Do you think you'll have a dream?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think you'll have a dream?"

dialogues.jp:
ベッドに寝転んだ俺を、静かな湖面のような視
線が見下ろす。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked at me calmly as I lie down on the bed.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked at me calmly as I lie down on the bed.

dialogues.jp: 「……どうかな」
dialogues.en: "I'm not sure......"
dialogues.text: "I'm not sure......"

dialogues.jp: 腕を目の上において、深く息をはきだす。
dialogues.en: I sighed deeply as I put my arm under my head.
dialogues.text: I sighed deeply as I put my arm under my head.

dialogues.jp: 「おかしい……眠くてさ……ごめん……」
dialogues.en: "It's so weird...... I'm really sleepy...... Sorry......"
dialogues.text: "It's so weird...... I'm really sleepy...... Sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ううん。おやすみ……お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. Good night, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. Good night, oniichan."

dialogues.jp: そっ、と。
dialogues.en: Very gently.
dialogues.text: Very gently.

dialogues.jp:
｛・・・・／お母さん｝のような雰囲気で、さくらがシーツを
俺にかぶせる。
dialogues.en: Sakura tucked me in to bed like she was my 'mother'.
dialogues.text: Sakura tucked me in to bed like she was my 'mother'.

dialogues.en: "Thanks......"
dialogues.text: "Thanks......"

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらとデートの約束◆
dialogues.en: ◆A promise to go on a date with Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆A promise to go on a date with Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
デートを美春たちに目撃され、自分の部屋で照
れた叫び声をあげる音夢。その音夢の声に、俺
は壁越しに答えていた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was going crazy in her room since Miharu and Kotori saw
us together at the park. I was answering to her comments
from my room next door.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was going crazy in her room since Miharu and Kotori saw
us together at the park. I was answering to her comments
from my room next door.

dialogues.jp:
そろそろやめさせようと思った時に、さくらが
様子を見に窓からやって来た。
dialogues.en:
Sakura came to see how we're doing as I was wondering if I
should stop Nemu.
dialogues.text:
Sakura came to see how we're doing as I was wondering if I
should stop Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず音夢を落ち着かせ、さくらと明日買
い物に出かける約束をして眠りにつく。なんだ
か異様に眠かった……。
dialogues.en:
I calmed Nemu down. Sakura and I made a plan to go out
tomorrow, and I went to sleep. I was really sleepy.
dialogues.text:
I calmed Nemu down. Sakura and I made a plan to go out
tomorrow, and I went to sleep. I was really sleepy.
